items.label: F6
items.front: F6 (Medium): what is wrong here? Evidence: `src/services/anomalyService.ts:53-55`, `src/repositories/anomalyRepository.ts:36-39`
items.back: `refresh=true` inserts a fresh copy of every anomaly each call (no dedupe), and the read filters by `detectedAt`, so refreshing a past month returns nothing new.

items.label: F5
items.back: Jobs are lost on restart; PENDING runs are never recovered. If the FAILED write in the catch itself throws, the rejection escapes the `setTimeout` callback unhandled.

items.label: F1
items.front: F1 (Critical): Authentication is a bare `x-user-id` header. Evidence: `src/lib/auth/session.ts:13-22`, `src/lib/http/client.ts:7,31`
items.back: Any caller with a user id is that user; the id the UI uses is shipped in the public bundle via `NEXT_PUBLIC_`.

items.label: F10
items.front: F10 (Low): `limit`/`offset` are unvalidated `Number(...)`: NaN → 500, negative or huge values pass through. Evidence: `src/app/api/cost-line-items/route.ts:27-28`
items.back: `monthQuerySchema` (`src/lib/validation/reportSchemas.ts:9-12`) exists but no route uses it.

items.label: F12
items.front: F12 (Low): The "forecast" for month M is 1.08 × M's own actuals; refreshing the current month changes the prediction as data arrives. Evidence: `src/services/forecastService.ts:12-17`

items.label: F13
items.front: F13 (Info): what is wrong here? Evidence: `src/app/api/budgets/route.ts:23-28`
items.back: `TEAM_MANAGER` can create budgets for any team in the tenant, as the in-code note at `:24` already admits.

items.label: F7
items.front: F7 (Medium): Money handled as JS `number` from `Decimal`; per-row amounts are not rounded before writing `Decimal(12,2)`, so team/project totals can drift from the input total by cents. Evidence: `src/services/allocationEngineService.ts:56,79,91`

items.label: F9
items.front: F9 (Low): what is wrong here? Evidence: `src/services/allocationEngineService.ts:99`
items.back: `summary.matchedRules` reports `rules.length` (all active rules), not matched rules.

items.label: F11
items.front: F11 (Low): what is wrong here? Evidence: `src/services/ingestionService.ts:12-34`
items.back: Re-ingesting the same export duplicates every line item; no natural key or upsert, despite the comment at `:13` about idempotent refeeds.

items.label: F3
items.front: F3 (High): Body-supplied `teamId`/`projectId` are never checked against the caller's tenant; relations are id-only. Evidence: `src/services/allocationRuleService.ts:20-28`, `src/services/budgetService.ts:13-21`, `src/services/ingestionService.ts:14-26`, `prisma/schema.prisma:148-149`

items.label: F8
items.front: F8 (Medium): what is wrong here? Evidence: `prisma/schema.prisma:156-173`
items.back: No uniqueness on `(tenantId, monthStart)` for runs and no in-flight check in `createRunAndQueue`; concurrent runs for one month race, and the report silently picks the latest completed.
